svg.title: One eight-column microkernel walking packed B
svg.desc: In the old packed macro-panel, the kernel reads columns zero through seven at K zero, passes over the remaining columns of that K slice, then reads columns zero through seven at K one: a max_jj-double stride. In the new layout, the two K slices for columns zero through seven are adjacent: an eight-double stride. Gray regions represent the remaining column panels.
